0022600229.text: The Timberwolves host the Mavericks in Minnesota's 12th game of the season, with Minnesota (8-3, 1st in the Northwest, 4th in the West) riding a four-game winning streak and a 7-3 record over its last ten, while Dallas (7-4, 9th in the West) has won three straight and also sits at 7-3 over its last ten. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points per game this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a leg injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and Minnesota won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 124-94 in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
